Movia

Puro

SparklingWine district with protected designation of origin (ZGP) Goriška Brda

A Movia sparkling wine sold undisgorged, with its lees in the bottle, for the consumer to disgorge on opening.

Puro is one of the most original wines from Movia, the Kristančič family estate in Goriška Brda. In its white version it is made from Chardonnay and Rebula; there is also a rosé version from Pinot Noir. After the first fermentation and ageing of the base wine, the second fermentation takes place in the bottle, and the wine then stays on its lees for a long period.

What sets it apart is that it is released undisgorged: the lees have collected in the neck of the bottle, which is kept upside down, and the consumer must open it, preferably with the bottle inverted and under water, to expel the sediment before serving. The wine thus reaches the glass without sulphur added after ageing and with the character of a freshly disgorged sparkling wine. It is a dry wine with fine bubbles and great personality.

Tasting profile

Golden yellow, fine bubbles. Notes of toast, yeast, apple, citrus and nuts. Dry, creamy, vibrant palate.

Food pairing

Oysters, shellfish, aperitifs, raw fish, aged cheeses

Serving

6-8 °C, white-wine or tulip glass; open with the bottle inverted
